# Development

- [Code Quality](./code-quality.md) — Maintain strict Biome rules, browser/build boundaries, generated-code exclusions, and narrow exceptions that preserve cohesive module contracts.
- [Development Workflow](./workflow.md) — Use the correct build order, rebuild local fixture dependencies, distinguish TypeScript execution modes, and keep generated files disposable.
- [Packaging and Publishing](./publishing.md) — Preserve React/build entrypoints, tarball completeness, the compatibility command, root-lock release checks, and publication verification.
